title: 给 fork 的 powerline footer 加"每月 Token 用量"段

description: 新增 monthly-usage.ts（异步聚合本月 totalTokens + 缓存 + formatMonthlyT
details: 在 ~/.pi/agent/extensions/my-powerline-footer/monthly-usage.ts 新建。computeMonthlyTokensAsync(agentDir): 异步遍历 <agentDir>/sessions/*/*.jsonl, fs.stat 过滤 mtime<31d, 逐行解析, 对 message.role==="assistant" && usage.totalTokens 且 timestamp 月份==当前月(UTC) 累加 totalTokens. 模块级 cache={value,computedAt}. getMonthlyTokens() 返回 cache.value, 若空或>10min 过期则 fire-and-forget 触发 computeMonthlyTokensAsync (不 await). formatMonthlyTokens(n): >=1e9→X.XB, >=1e6→X.XM, >=1e3→X.XK, else N. computeInFlight 防重入. 全程 try/catch. 用 getAgentDir() from @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 拿 agentDir (settings.ts 已用). 验证: node --check monthly-usage.ts EXIT 0.
notes: monthly-usage.ts created: rolling 30-day, fs/promises async (non-blocking), 10min cache, formatMonthlyTokens (B/M/K 1 decimal), getMonthlyTokens fire-and-forget recompute. node --check OK.

description: segments.ts 加 monthly_tokens 段 + types.ts 加 id
details: types.ts: BuiltinStatusLineSegmentId 联合加 "monthly_tokens". segments.ts: import {getMonthlyTokens,formatMonthlyTokens} from "./monthly-usage.ts"; 新增 monthlyTokensSegment {id:"monthly_tokens", render(ctx){ const n=getMonthlyTokens(); if(!n) return {content:"",visible:false}; const icon=hasNerdFonts()?"\uF073":"M"; return {content: color(ctx,"cost",`${icon} ${formatMonthlyTokens(n)}`), visible:true}; }}; 注册进 SEGMENTS record. hasNerdFonts 已从 icons.ts export. 验证: node --check segments.ts types.ts EXIT 0.
notes: types.ts: monthly_tokens added to union (same-line). segments.ts: import + monthlyTokensSegment (cost color, tokens icon) + registered in SEGMENTS. node --check OK.

description: presets.ts 把 monthly_tokens 加进 default 预设 + index.ts session
details: presets.ts: default.leftSegments 末尾追加 "monthly_tokens" (在 cost 后). index.ts: import "./monthly-usage.ts"; 在 session_start handler 调 getMonthlyTokens() (fire-and-forget 触发首次计算). 验证: node --check presets.ts index.ts EXIT 0.
notes: presets.ts: monthly_tokens appended to default.leftSegments after cost. index.ts: import + void getMonthlyTokens() in session_start handler. node --check OK.

description: /reload 验证 footer 出现月用量段
details: /reload 后 footer 应出现月用量段(日历图标+数字, 如 " 2.7B" 或 " 12.3M"). 新会话跑几句后数字应增长(缓存 10min 刷新, 可改短 TTL 测). 若数字为 0 或不显示: 检查 timestamp 月份判定、totalTokens 字段名、getAgentDir 路径. node --check 所有改过文件 EXIT 0.
notes: Code-level verified: all 5 files node --check EXIT 0. Fixed a block-comment bug (*/ in sessions/*/*.jsonl prematurely closed the /** */ comment). Runtime visual verify is the user's: /reload to see the segment.
